paragraphs: Review protocols and endpoints in the morning and define the statistical plan. Align hypotheses with the medical team at midday and adjust the design. Before submission, review robustness through several revisions. Run analyses and simulations and write submission material in the afternoon, then organize the review checklist and prepare for regulatory questions.

In one sentence: turn trial data into evidence that passes review. Work includes statistical design, endpoint analysis, submission writing, regulatory communication, validation, and bias control. It combines analysis with regulatory rigor as the evidence center of R&D.
